Cybersecurity for business

Cybersecurity built for the age of AI. Less exposure, more control.

Vulnerabilities are now found and exploited far faster than before. We help organizations know what they expose online, fix it quickly and recover if something goes wrong.

Context

The time to patch has shrunk

In October 2026 two critical flaws in the core of PHP, found with the help of artificial intelligence, received emergency fixes.

Services

One cycle, from prevention to recovery

01Prevent
  • Inventory of versions and components
  • Updating PHP and applications
  • Checking with the hosting provider
02Detect
  • Checks for suspicious files and access
  • Server log analysis
  • Verification after every critical advisory
03Respond
  • Rotating passwords, keys and tokens
  • Guidance if a compromise emerges
  • Written report of what was done
04Recover
  • Backup set up and checked
  • Restore test
  • Written restart procedure

E-commerce

Method

How an engagement works

01Written engagement

We define in writing which systems are in scope. We do not work on anything that is not yours.

02Assessment

We check versions, configuration and signs of compromise, and give you a clear picture.

03Intervention

Updates and fixes agreed in advance, with the price set before we start.

04Report

What we checked, what we changed, what is left to do. No promises of absolute security.
